comment: Same source continuation for ask52289/Common0.31.7 from frozen PR9. Existing platform waiver is historical; actual source guard, native conformance and installable TestFlight proof remain required.
name: ForIT Glasses
textScreensWhy: The AEB115CE work order covers a voice client: speech transcripts and generated replies are transient, with no retained user-authored document to edit; settings edit their values directly.

offline.why: Voice replies require the live ForIT AI Engine, and glasses control requires connected hardware. There is no retained document collection to synchronize; API and voice preferences remain local.

hosts.forit-ai-engine.azurewebsites.net: own backend: the voice endpoint and its error-log endpoint
hosts.api.elevenlabs.io: external speech synthesis provider selected by the person's ElevenLabs API key

waivers.PL-2..5: Native Mac and Vision Pro targets and Watch distribution were already missing on baseline 45b52531. Dispatch 2026-10-14 directs those existing gaps to open task 5BBB3471-E5DA-48AD-B1BB-2A83A5B0D4E2 under epic 73E7B446, without an invented future due date. This mark release updates and compiles the Watch source but claims delivery only on the existing iOS channel; Dispatch is starting the platform worker.
